# University of Groningen Research Portal

> Central hub for discovering research activities, faculty expertise, and institutional collaboration across the University of Groningen's academic divisions and sustainable development initiatives.

The University of Groningen research portal provides comprehensive access to faculty directories, research organization structures, and collaborative networks across nine academic faculties and specialized research campuses. The portal emphasizes alignment with UN Sustainable Development Goals and facilitates research discovery through institutional browsing and research fingerprinting.

## Key Topics

- University of Groningen
- Sustainable Development Goals
- Research Portal
- Faculty Organization
- Campus Fryslân

## Portal Home & Overview

- [University of Groningen Research Portal](https://research.rug.nl): Main entry point to the research portal with faculty and campus directory
- [University of Groningen Research Portal - English](https://research.rug.nl/en/home): English language homepage for the University of Groningen research portal
- [University of Groningen Research Portal - Index](https://research.rug.nl/en/home/index): Indexed research portal homepage with faculty and institutional directory

## University Organization & Administration

- [University of Groningen](https://research.rug.nl/en/organisations/university-of-groningen): Main organization page with research units and UN Sustainable Development Goals alignment

## Academic Faculties

- [Faculty of Medical Sciences/UMCG](https://research.rug.nl/en/organisations/faculty-of-medical-sciencesumcg): Clinical and health research collaboration with University Medical Center Groningen
- [Faculty of Economics and Business](https://research.rug.nl/en/organisations/faculty-of-economics-and-business): Research focused on supply chain, international business, and economic development
- [Faculty of Law](https://research.rug.nl/en/organisations/faculty-of-law): Legal research with emphasis on international law and human rights
- [Faculty of Behavioural and Social Sciences](https://research.rug.nl/en/organisations/faculty-of-behavioural-and-social-sciences): Psychology and social sciences research with collaboration networks
- [Faculty of Arts](https://research.rug.nl/en/organisations/faculty-of-arts): Arts research profiles and sustainable development initiatives

## Specialized Research Campuses

- [Campus Fryslân](https://research.rug.nl/en/organisations/campus-frysl%C3%A2n): Leeuwarden campus specializing in artificial intelligence, big data, and sustainable development research
